svg.text: Design system · Sun Club × Rainbow Spaces
Recipe cards traded between home cooks around the world.
Soft brights on cream, purple type. Black only in the pack opening.
Built-in iOS stand-ins for Zenon, Soleil and Whitenice.
Share your location and we'll show recipes from home cooks in your area first.
Leaf for actions, swatch for choices, frame for illustrations, bubble for every icon.
Uppercase labels, haptic on every press, at most one primary per screen.
Each tier steps up border, shadow and art panel so rarity reads at a glance.
Little ink guys in pastel bubbles by food type; stickers scattered two to four per screen.
